from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialData(BaseModel):
    """Financial data for a single company extracted from one document."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company as reported in the document")
    stock_code: str | None = Field(description="Stock code of the company, e.g., '000006'")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period string, e.g., '2025 Q1' or '2025-03'")
    operating_revenue: float | None = Field(description="Operating Revenue value for the period")
    operating_total_cost: float | None = Field(description="Operating Total Cost value for the period")
    financial_expenses: float | None = Field(description="Financial Expenses value for the period")
    net_profit_attributable_to_shareholders: float | None = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders value for the period")
    currency: str | None = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency unit for the financial figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    companies: list[CompanyFinancialData] = Field(description="List of companies with their financial data extracted from the documents")
